title: Copilot FC SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Frontmatter schema for skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Delta vs existing layers: waza check reports spec compliance/token budgets (advisory) and workspace-check gates metadata.version. This schema adds blocking structure: kebab name <=64, description 10-1024, required metadata.version, and rejects unknown top-level keys.

name.description: Kebab-case skill identifier; must equal the containing directory name (enforced by scripts/workspace/check-consistency.ps1).

description.description: The router: written for skill discovery. Follow the USE FOR / DO NOT USE FOR partitioning convention documented in skills/README.md. Blocking floor+ceiling, validated by scripts/workspace/validate-manifests.py.

metadata.description: Bookkeeping block. version (semver) is required and gated; author recommended; auxiliary keys (lastVerified, tags, ...) are permitted.

argument-hint.description: Placeholder hint when the skill is invoked as a slash command.

user-invocable.description: Copilot harness key: whether the user can invoke the skill directly.

disable-model-invocation.description: Copilot harness key: prevent the model from invoking the skill automatically; manual invocation only.

version.description: LEGACY top-level version key; prefer metadata.version. Tolerated while cap and context7-cli still declare it.
